faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: How can I modify my booking?
faq.a1: You can modify your booking by logging into your account and accessing 'My Bookings'. Click on the relevant booking and select 'Modify'. Note that fees may apply depending on fare conditions.
faq.a2: We accept credit cards (Visa, Mastercard), Mobile Money (Orange Money, MTN Money, Moov Money), and bank transfers. Cash payment is possible at our agencies.
faq.q3: How can I get a refund?
faq.a3: Refund requests must be submitted through your account within 24h after cancellation. Processing time is 7 to 14 business days depending on your bank.
faq.a4: Yes, children are welcome. Reduced rates are available for children under 12. Some services offer free travel for children under 2.
faq.q5: What documents are needed for travel?
faq.a5: For international flights, a valid passport is mandatory. Depending on the destination, a visa may be required. For domestic flights, an ID card is sufficient. Check our destination guide for more information.
faq.q6: What to do in case of flight delay or cancellation?
faq.a6: In case of delay or cancellation, contact our customer service immediately available 24/7. We will assist you in finding an alternative solution or processing your refund.

booking.q1: How can I modify my booking?
booking.a1: You can modify your booking by logging into your account and accessing 'My Bookings'. Click on the relevant booking and select 'Modify'. Note that fees may apply depending on fare conditions.
booking.q2: How can I check my booking status?
booking.a2: Go to 'My Bookings' from your dashboard: each booking shows its status (confirmed, pending, cancelled) along with all your trip details.
booking.q3: Can I cancel my booking online?
booking.a3: Yes, cancellation is done directly from 'My Bookings' by selecting 'Cancel'. Cancellation conditions and any fees depend on the fare chosen at booking time.
booking.q4: Do I need an account to book?
booking.a4: An account isn't required to book, but it lets you easily find your bookings, receive price alerts, and speed up future bookings.

payment.a1: We accept credit cards (Visa, Mastercard), Mobile Money (Orange Money, MTN Money, Moov Money), and bank transfers. Cash payment is possible at our agencies.
payment.q2: What should I do if I get a payment error?
payment.a2: If your payment fails, check the balance and details of your payment method and try again. If the issue persists, contact our support with your booking reference.
payment.q3: How can I get my invoice?
payment.a3: Your invoice is available in 'My Bookings' once payment is confirmed, and is also sent to you by email. You can download it as a PDF at any time.
payment.a4: Yes, all payments are processed via Jèko with secure encryption. We never store your card details on our servers.

refunds.q1: How can I get a refund?
refunds.a1: Refund requests must be submitted through your account within 24h after cancellation. Processing time is 7 to 14 business days depending on your bank.
refunds.a2: Cancellation fees vary depending on the fare booked (refundable, semi-flexible or non-refundable) and how far ahead of departure you cancel. Details are shown before you confirm your booking.
refunds.q3: How long does a refund take?
refunds.a3: Refunds are processed within 7 to 14 business days after your request is validated; the final timing depends on your bank or Mobile Money operator.
refunds.q4: Can I cancel only part of my booking?
refunds.a4: Yes, for multi-item bookings (several passengers or combined services), you can cancel partially from 'My Bookings' or by contacting our support.

baggage.a1: The baggage allowance depends on the fare and carrier chosen; it's detailed at booking time and on your flight confirmation.
baggage.q2: How do I add extra baggage?
baggage.a2: You can add extra baggage from 'My Bookings' before departure, or directly through our support for special cases.
baggage.q3: What should I do if my baggage is lost or damaged?
baggage.a3: Report the issue immediately at the airport baggage counter before leaving the claim area, then contact our support with your booking reference for follow-up.
baggage.q4: What items are prohibited in checked or carry-on baggage?
baggage.a4: Sharp objects, flammable liquids and loose lithium batteries are prohibited in carry-on baggage; some hazardous items are also prohibited in checked baggage. Check your carrier's rules before packing.

children.a1: Yes, children are welcome. Reduced rates are available for children under 12. Some services offer free travel for children under 2.
children.a2: Unaccompanied minors can travel under certain conditions depending on the carrier, with a parental authorization form and sometimes a paid escort service.
children.q3: Does a minor need a special document?
children.a3: A minor travelling alone or with only one parent may need an exit authorization signed by both parents or the legal guardian, depending on the destination.
children.a4: Baby seats and bassinet options are available on request with some partner carriers and hotels; mention this need when booking.

documents.q1: What documents are needed for travel?
documents.a1: For international flights, a valid passport is mandatory. Depending on the destination, a visa may be required. For domestic flights, an ID card is sufficient. Check our destination guide for more information.
documents.q2: How do I get a visa for my destination?
documents.a2: Visa requirements vary by nationality and destination. Check with the relevant embassy or consulate, or our concierge service, which can assist with the process.
documents.q3: Does my passport need a minimum validity period?
documents.a3: Most countries require a passport valid for at least 6 months after the planned return date. Always check the specific requirements for your destination before travelling.
documents.q4: Is an ID card enough for a domestic flight?
documents.a4: Yes, for domestic flights within Côte d'Ivoire, a valid national ID card is sufficient for boarding.

delays.q1: What to do in case of flight delay or cancellation?
delays.a1: In case of delay or cancellation, contact our customer service immediately available 24/7. We will assist you in finding an alternative solution or processing your refund.
delays.q2: Am I entitled to compensation for a delay?
delays.a2: Compensation eligibility depends on the carrier, the length of the delay and its cause. Our support team helps you check your eligibility and submit your claim.
delays.q3: How can I track my flight status in real time?
delays.a3: Your flight status is visible in 'My Bookings', with automatic notifications for schedule or gate changes.
delays.q4: What should I do if I miss my connection due to a delay?
delays.a4: Go immediately to your carrier's counter at the airport to be rebooked on the next available flight, and inform our support so we can follow up on your case.

q0.question: How do I create an account on Bossiz+?
q0.answer: Click "Login" at the top of the page then "Create an account". Fill in your information and confirm your email.

q1.question: How do I contact customer support?
q1.answer: You can contact us via the form on the Support page, by email or by phone, available 24/7.

q2.question: Can I edit my personal information?
q2.answer: Yes, go to your dashboard, "Account" section, to edit your information at any time.

q0.question: How do I book a flight?
q0.answer: Use the flight search engine on the homepage, select your dates and destinations, then choose the offer that suits you.

q1.question: Can I change or cancel my flight?
q1.answer: Changes and cancellations depend on your ticket's fare conditions. Check your booking in your dashboard.

q2.question: How do I get my boarding pass?
q2.answer: Your boarding pass is sent by email after check-in, and is also available in your bookings area.

q3.question: What is the baggage policy?
q3.answer: The baggage policy varies depending on the airline and fare selected. It is shown during booking.

q0.question: How do I book a hotel?
q0.answer: Search for your destination, select your dates and number of travelers, then choose your preferred accommodation.

q1.question: Can I cancel my hotel booking?
q1.answer: This depends on the property's cancellation policy, shown before your booking is confirmed.

q2.question: How do I contact the hotel before my arrival?
q2.answer: The hotel's contact details are in your confirmation email and in your booking details.

q0.question: What payment methods do you accept?
q0.answer: We accept credit cards, mobile money and transfers via our secure payment partners.

q1.question: Are my payments secure?
q1.answer: Yes, all transactions are encrypted and processed by certified payment providers.

q2.question: Can I get an invoice?
q2.answer: Yes, an invoice is available in your bookings area after each confirmed payment.

q3.question: What should I do if a payment fails?
q3.answer: Check your banking information and try again. If the problem persists, contact our support.

q0.question: What documents are needed to rent a car?
q0.answer: A valid driver's license, an ID and a credit card in the driver's name are required.

q1.question: Is insurance included?
q1.answer: Basic insurance is included; additional options are available during booking.

q2.question: Can I return the vehicle in another city?
q2.answer: This depends on the rental agency; this option is shown during booking if available.
